items.question: What is DSR CoDesign?
items.answer: DSR CoDesign is an open-source desktop AI design tool. It turns natural-language prompts into HTML prototypes, React components, slide decks, PDFs, and marketing assets while running on the user's laptop with user-controlled model access.

items.question: Is DSR CoDesign free?
items.answer: Yes. DSR CoDesign is MIT licensed and free to download, use, modify, and redistribute. Users pay only the model provider they choose, when that provider is paid.

items.question: Which AI models does DSR CoDesign support?
items.answer: DSR CoDesign supports Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, local Ollama, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, keyless IP-allowlisted proxies, and ChatGPT Plus / Codex subscription login.

items.question: Does DSR CoDesign send my prompts or designs to the cloud?
items.answer: No. Designs, prompts, settings, generated files, and v0.2 workspace-backed sessions stay on the user's machine by default. The only outbound network traffic is to the model provider the user configures.

items.question: Which platforms are supported?
items.answer: DSR CoDesign supports macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, Windows x64, Windows ARM64, and Linux packages including AppImage, deb, and rpm.

items.question: Which package managers are live for v0.2.0?
items.answer: GitHub Releases, Homebrew Cask, and Scoop are live for v0.2.0. The winget manifest has been submitted and is waiting for Microsoft review.
